top_speed_kmh.src_label: Porsche Cars North America, 2011 911 Carrera 4 / Carrera 4S Specifications (997.2, US market; no MY2012 sheet found)
top_speed_kmh.note: Carrera 4 columns of the 'Top Track Speed' row are Manual 177 mph (284 km/h), PDK 175 mph (282 km/h), PDK with Sport Chrono 175 mph (282 km/h); the PDK value is used.

zero_to_100_kmh_s.src_label: auto-data.net, Porsche 911 (997, facelift 2008) Carrera 4 3.6 (345 Hp) PDK
zero_to_100_kmh_s.note: PDK; the same value is in Wikipedia's 997 performance table (PDK 0-100: 4.8, with Sport Plus 4.6). Manual is 5.0.

zero_to_60_mph_s.src_label: Porsche Cars North America, 2011 911 Carrera 4 / Carrera 4S Specifications (997.2, US market; no MY2012 sheet found)
zero_to_60_mph_s.quote: 4.8 sec. 4.6 sec. 4.4 sec. 4.5 sec. 4.3 sec. 4.1 sec.
zero_to_60_mph_s.note: columns are Carrera 4 Manual 4.8 / PDK 4.6 / PDK with Sport Chrono Package Plus 4.4, then the same three for the 4S. 4.6 s is the plain PDK; the 4.4 s needs the Sport Chrono Package, which the listing does not mention. Recorded as 0-60 mph.

power_kw.note: Porsche's US sheet prints '345 hp', which is the metric 345 PS (254 kW), not SAE hp (that would be 257 kW); the Wikipedia row gives all three.
